title: Ki Value Objects - Bai Sandeep Maheshwari
description: "The only person you should compare yourself to is YOU."  Sandeep Maheshwari is a name among millions who struggled, failed and surged ahead in search of success, happiness and contentment. Just like any middle class guy, he too had a bunch of unclear dreams and a blurred vision of his goals in life. All he had was an undying learning attitude to hold on to. Rowing through ups and downs, it was time that taught him the true meaning of his life.  To know more, log on to www.sandeepmaheshwari.com Connect with him at Facebook.com/SandeepMaheshwariPage Watch his inspirational videos at Youtube.com/SandeepSeminars  Music: Youtube Music Library

asr.full_text: The interview with Mr. Siddharth Bhai The interview with Mr. Siddharth Bhai Shall I say something first? My look! How many say that clean shift is better? I am voting like this How many say that this is better? This is better! How many were clean shift? Throw them out, they have support Sir, I gave an interview and there was one person with me who was very stressed out and every second he was telling me what will happen inside, what will they ask, I am very scared, what will happen if it doesn't happen and one of the people who was saying that I didn't want to go there, so I said that I just came to check how capable I am, so it happened, it didn't happen, it didn't happen, so I was very chilled out, I I am. It was done, but not done. I was very chilled out. I was telling everyone that if I didn't do it, something else would happen. With me, we gave the same interview. We were in the same qualification. I scored more marks than him. He got rejected and I got selected for the Rousla. After going inside, I answered very confidently. He was very scared. He was like, how will I do it? He was like this every time. How will I do it, how will I do it? Every time he said that he will not be able to do it and then he did not do it. You said something very amazing. Let's give a big hand for him. Please have a seat. Look, one person is scared in the interview, one is that he is not getting any difference. So what is the difference between the two? If you look carefully, one has gone there to crack that interview One is there for fun Means it doesn't make any difference if it doesn't happen And the other person is afraid of this thought that if it doesn't happen then don't know what will happen Now here is a very interesting contradiction That if you want to be successful Whatever you want, you are playing a game And you want to win Then then you have a lot of chances to lose. And if you are playing to play, then there is no way to defeat you. If both are equal in skill, then conditions apply. Understand this carefully. If there is a difference in the background, then there is no need to think about all this. One is a graduate and the other is not So graduate has done because it was written there that he is for graduate So he made the other one out Now we are not talking about this We are saying that only one college has two students And one is scared and the other is not So what is the cause of fear? We are trying to find that out You can call it fear, stress or pressure Because of which our capability The level at which we can perform we can't perform Because the more you think about that success That my job interview will crack The more you will get scared The fear of not being there See what difference there was in both One was that I should get a job Other desire could be how much fun it will be I am going for an interview I am going for the first time Let me see what happens there Meaning you are acting out of curiosity Like a child Ok it happened, it didn't happen, it doesn't matter What difference does it make If it doesn't happen here then it doesn't life end? Even if it happens then it doesn't mean that I will live here for the rest of my life. It can be that I will leave it after 4 days. This also happens, doesn't it? So what I mean to say is that It's not like this is happening or that is happening You are excited about the process. On one hand you are excited only about the outcome. If you get the job, you will enjoy it. Otherwise, you will be in a bad situation. That if you get the job, you will enjoy it or else you will be in a bad state. So you will live like a coward. Why? Because you will be scared. If you get a job, won't that person work in fear? If you throw me out of here, I will get ruined. What will get ruined? And then if the people above him come and tell him, will make him dance like a puppet. That you have to do all these wrong things in this world. Will he do or not? Then where is his life left? He has become a puppet. He has a string in his hand. He is making him dance. For example, there is a person who thinks that I want to become a top star. Means in Bollywood, in Bombay, if you know, daily who get off the train every day to become a hero. What is their state? Bad or good? We have observed their lives practically, what kind of conditions they have? I know what the story really is, I have been pushed so I know what is inside It is a very bad condition So bad that there is no limit They are all the wrong Why are you dying? Because they want to be a hero Now if someone will show them a dream Or they will find a way I will make you a hero But what I will do is He will do or he say Will he or will he not? Whats left so far? Are you searching? If people know him, he is taking wrong steps To be the person he wants to be Even if he becomes a good actor, nothing will remain. I am an actor now, should I become an actor? He just continues to live with the same thought and live on with negativity. There is no hope of any positive outcome.
